== Manual session live view

- Fixed an issue where the live view in a manual session could drop to a lower frame rate after a brief interruption in the device screen stream and stay laggy for the rest of the session. The live view now returns to smooth video automatically, typically within a few seconds. This issue most often affected iOS devices.
